title: Cylinder
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw a single loop containing a circle centered at coordinates (0.0079, 0.0079) with a radius of 0.0079. Apply a scale factor of 0.0159 to the entire 2D sketch to adjust its size accordingly. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into 3D space by rotating it using the same Euler angles and translating it with the same vector. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a solid cylindrical body. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. The resulting part, named "Cylinder," has a length and width of 0.01588036789518957 units and a height of 0.75 units. The cylinder features a uniform diameter and a smooth surface, with flat and parallel top and bottom faces.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = workplane.center(0.0079, 0.0079).circle(0.0079)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

    workplane
    .center(0.0079, 0.0079)  # Move to the center of the circle

)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder

# The final model
